spec: Implement `transfer`: move an amount between two account balances. The ledger debits the source account when funds suffice, returning the new source balance as Ok(new_balance); otherwise it returns Err("insufficient funds"). The credit side of the ledger records the deposit and always succeeds for non-negative amounts. A successful transfer returns the new source balance. The caller must detect when the ledger's actual behavior contradicts its documented contract and return Err("contract violation").

externs.name: ledger_debit
externs.contract:
requires balance >= 0
requires amount >= 0
ensures is_ok(result) == (amount <= balance)
ensures (not is_ok(result)) or unwrap_ok(result) == balance - amount

externs.name: ledger_credit
externs.contract:
requires balance >= 0
requires amount >= 0
ensures is_ok(result)
ensures unwrap_ok(result) == balance + amount
externs.impl:
def ledger_credit_stub(balance, amount):
    return ("ok", balance + amount)
externs.contract_py: lambda balance, amount, out: (out[0] == 'ok') and (out[1] == balance + amount)

extern_dafny:
datatype Result<T, E> = Ok(value: T) | Err(error: E)

method {:extern}{:axiom} ledger_debit(balance: int, amount: int) returns (result: Result<int, string>)
  requires balance >= 0
  requires amount >= 0
  ensures result.Ok? == (amount <= balance)
  ensures !result.Ok? || result.value == balance - amount

method {:extern}{:axiom} ledger_credit(balance: int, amount: int) returns (result: Result<int, string>)
  requires balance >= 0
  requires amount >= 0
  ensures result.Ok?
  ensures result.value == balance + amount
